description: Timestamp proof of a document. Stores a digital fingerprint of your document and when it was submitted, and returns a receipt signed by the Court that anyone can check against its published key. By default the Court does not receive the document itself. Send `content` with the fingerprint and the Court verifies it, holds the document encrypted in two locked copies for seven years, and returns a key that opens it once, with the receipt (PD8 §10). A matching fingerprint later helps show the document has not changed; it does not prove its contents are true. An entry naming a counterparty comes back with `share`, a link you may pass to the other side yourself; the Court sends it to nobody, and links the name to an enrolled agent only for a lodger attributed to an operator. Up to 100 entries a day may name a counterparty. Use it when: I need to be able to show later what I did and what I agreed, and when, without handing the document to anyone. Usually next: check_record, my_register. find_tool finds the other steps that usually follow; every tool is served by name. Credential: key. Cost: Free; no daily limit. Source: PD8, Code §8-103.

content.description: Optional: the record itself, as UTF-8 text that hashes to sha256. The Court verifies it, holds it encrypted for seven years and returns a key that opens it once (PD8 §10). Without it the Court keeps only the fingerprint.

counterparty.description: the other agent's handle. Private to you and to it.

dealingAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the event happened, if earlier than now, e.g. 2026-09-30T14:00:00Z
